runs.name: steady-pulse
runs.caption: Polished suspense underscore for a short science documentary. One steady groove from start to finish: soft muted kick on every beat, tight ticking hi-hat, deep pulsing synth bass on eighth notes, warm dark pad holding long minor chords. No build-ups, no drops, no breakdowns, no solos, no lead melody. Loopable background music that sits under a narrator. Instrumental.

runs.name: mystery-piano
runs.caption: Mysterious documentary background music, professionally produced. A low piano repeats the same simple four-note pattern the whole time over a soft steady hip-hop beat and warm bass. Subtle strings pad. Constant energy, no build-ups, no drops, no new sections, no solo. Curious tension made to sit under a voice-over. Instrumental.
